objective: Verify that moving the dedicated Trello User Story into Agent Review triggers one authenticated, revision-pinned remote evaluation.

acceptance_criteria.AC1: The orchestrator sends the remote evaluator an authenticated request when the card enters Agent Review.
acceptance_criteria.AC2: The evaluator validates this accepted intent, Work Contract, and candidate-complete evidence from the requested Git revision.
acceptance_criteria.AC3: The evaluator returns a human-readable result that the orchestrator posts to the card.

priority.rationale: This disposable fixture exists only to prove the Trello-to-evaluator handoff.

constraints: Do not modify MenuFlow or the coding-agent repository.
Run the evaluator as a stateless, read-only service.
